description: Auto-format files after Copilot edits them (Prettier for frontend, black for Python)

PostToolUse.command: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8')); const f=p.toolUse?.result?.filePath||''; if(!f)process.exit(0); if(f.endsWith('.ts')||f.endsWith('.tsx')||f.endsWith('.css')||f.endsWith('.json')) { require('child_process').execSync('npx prettier --write '+f, {cwd:'demo', stdio:'pipe'}); console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'Formatted: '+f})); }"

windows.command: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const f=p.toolUse?.result?.filePath||''; if(!f)process.exit(0); if(f.endsWith('.ts')||f.endsWith('.tsx')||f.endsWith('.css')||f.endsWith('.json')) { require('child_process').execSync('npx prettier --write '+f, {cwd:'demo', stdio:'pipe'}); console.log(JSON.stringify({message:'Formatted: '+f})); }"
